title: Evaluation of finite-variable power series in an adically complete ring
statement:
Let $C,T$ be commutative rings, $\alpha:C	o T$ a unital ring homomorphism, $I\subseteq T$ an ideal such that $T$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], $n\ge0$, and $b_1,\ldots,b_n\in I$. Then there is a unique ring homomorphism $E:C[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]	o T$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] which restricts to $\alpha$ on $C$, satisfies $E(X_i)=b_i$, and is continuous from the $(X_1,\ldots,X_n)$-adic topology to the $I$-adic topology. Explicitly, for $F=\sum_{
u\in\mathbf N^n}c_
u X^
u$, $E(F)$ is the unique element whose reduction modulo $I^N$ equals $\sum_{|
u|<N}\alpha(c_
u)b^
u$ for every $N\ge1$. Here $|
u|=\sum_i
u_i$ and $b^
u=\prod_i b_i^{
u_i}$. Continuity means that for each $N$ there is an $M$ such that $E((X_1,\ldots,X_n)^M)\subseteq I^N$.

Explicit algebraic version of the universal property used there.
